extraFacts.fact: SAE J517 gives the general, dimensional and performance specifications for the SAE 100R series of hydraulic hose, including 100R1 (single wire braid) and 100R2 (two wire braid).

SAE J1926-1 and ISO 11926-1 cover straight-thread O-ring boss (ORB) ports: the thread (UN/UNF) only holds the fitting, and the seal is made by an O-ring that is compressed against the chamfer of the port when the fitting is tightened.

SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2 cover 37° flared tube and hose fittings (JIC): the male 37° flare seats metal to metal against the 37° cone of the female swivel nut, and thread sizes are given by dash number, where each dash is one sixteenth of an inch (-04 is 4/16 in, or 1/4 in).

SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3 cover O-ring face seal (ORFS) fittings: an O-ring seated in a groove in the flat face of the male end seals against the flat face of the female swivel nut, so the seal is made by the O-ring and the thread only holds the joint together.

ASME B1.20.1 covers general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT is a taper thread with a 60° thread form that seals on the threads, and NPSM is a straight (parallel) thread for free-fitting mechanical joints that does not seal on the thread.

ISO 228-1 specifies pipe threads, designated G, where pressure-tight joints are not made on the threads: both the external and internal thread are parallel (BSPP). The seal is made by a washer, O-ring, bonded seal or sealing face, not by the thread flanks.

316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A240 / A276 chemical composition limits for UNS S31603

faqs.a: Yes. The Parker Fitting Reducers is kept in stock in Dubai, UAE, ready to ship worldwide with the best lead times. Use [our contact page](/contact) to send the part numbers and quantities you need.

faqs.q: What are Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps used for?
faqs.a: Parker hydraulic hose caps are female caps that blank off a hose end or fitting, in steel and stainless steel, from 1/4 inch to 2 inch fitting sizes. The stainless versions are listed as ORS (O-ring seal) caps.

faqs.q: How do I read Parker cap part numbers such as 24 FNL-SS?
faqs.a: In the size table the leading number is the dash size and the ending gives the material: 24 FNL-SS is the 1 1/2 inch stainless cap, and 24 FNL-S is the 1 1/2 inch steel one. 16 FNL-SS is the 1 inch stainless cap, and the FNMLS parts are steel.

faqs.q: Which sizes do the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps come in?
faqs.a: The 15 part numbers cover 1/4 inch to 2 inch fitting sizes, for example 4FNMLS (1/4 inch), 12FNMLS (3/4 inch), 16FNMLS (1 inch) and 32 FNL-S (2 inch). The stainless caps are listed at 5/8, 1, 1 1/4 and 1 1/2 inch.

faqs.q: Which Parker cap size do I need for a given hose end?
faqs.a: Match the cap to the fitting size on the hose end, not to the hose bore: the dash number is the fitting size, so a -16 fitting takes a 16 FNL cap. Send us the fitting part number or thread and we confirm the cap.

faqs.q: What pressure do the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps handle?
faqs.a: The rows give pressure by size: 634 bar for the 1/4, 3/8 and 1/2 inch steel caps, 414 bar from 5/8 to 1 1/4 inch, 345 bar at 1 1/2 inch and 207 bar at 2 inch. Check the row for the cap you order.

faqs.q: What are the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps made from?
faqs.a: The listing offers steel and stainless steel caps. The stainless versions, such as 16 FNL-SS and 24 FNL-SS, resist corrosion where a steel cap would rust; confirm the material in the part number before you order.

faqs.q: Which standard covers the sealing of the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps?
faqs.a: The stainless caps are listed as female ORS (O-ring seal), which is the face-seal form covered by SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3 for ORFS fittings, where an O-ring in the male face seals against the flat face. The listing names no standard of its own.

faqs.q: What do the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps fit onto?
faqs.a: They fit onto a male end of the same size and seal type, such as a male ORFS or the male end of a fitting on a hose, to blank it off. For ORFS stainless ends see our [SS316L ORFS fittings](/c/ss316l-orfs-fittings).

faqs.q: How should the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps be fitted?
faqs.a: Check the O-ring or seat is clean and undamaged, thread the cap on by hand and tighten to the torque for its size. A cap is not a substitute for relieving pressure: depressurise the line before fitting it.

faqs.q: Where are the Parker Hydraulic Hose Caps made, and what is their HS code?
faqs.a: The listing gives the United States as the country of origin and gives no HS code, which we confirm on the quotation. We ship from Dubai, UAE and prepare the commercial invoice and packing list.

faqs.q: Parker hose caps or Parker fitting reducers: what is the difference?
faqs.a: A cap blanks off a hose end or port, while the [Parker fitting reducers](/p/parker-fitting-reducers) change thread size. Different parts for different jobs, so check what the line needs.
